mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than the market average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0) signals a weak labor market, which typically indicates economic distress and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) and housing starts (HOUST < 700) signals a dual demand-supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when INDPRO < 95 and HOUST < 700 but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) compress equity valuations by increasing the cost of capital, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening cycles are not significantly lower than the market average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 130,000) signals robust economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 130,000, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low housing market activity (HOUST < 700) indicates weak consumer demand for housing, which typically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 700 but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) coincides with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2), it signals an environment of high inflation and low interest rates, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to uncertainty.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2 but 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 95), a decline in industrial production signals reduced economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95 but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
